fichas.title: Water spray extinguisher systems
fichas.summary: Permanently installed dry pipework with open nozzles releases water immediately when activated. Spray pattern and coverage are designed for the room, building, contents, storage, and wind conditions. Systems are grouped to protect areas and can supply nearby group areas simultaneously.
uses: Protect buildings, industrial facilities, flammable-liquid systems, and other listed areas from fire

dimensions.label: Water spray rate
dimensions.ocr_raw: must spray at a rate of 5–60 l/m²/min

dimensions.label: Protected area per group
dimensions.context: Area normally protected by systems arranged into groups.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Systems arranged into groups normally protect an area of 100–400 m² per group.

dimensions.label: Room area threshold
dimensions.context: Total effective area guidance applies to rooms at or above this area, divided into group effective areas.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The total effective area for rooms ≥200 m²

dimensions.label: Supply radius
dimensions.context: Group effective areas within this radius of the location at greatest fire risk can be supplied simultaneously.
dimensions.ocr_raw: within a radius of 7 m of the location at most risk

fichas.title: Oxygen-reducing extinguisher systems (CO₂ systems)
fichas.summary: Oxygen-reducing systems suppress combustion by lowering the oxygen content. The page describes CO₂ as a gaseous fire-fighting agent delivered rapidly through installed pipework and open nozzles, with detection, control, alarm, and activation equipment. Safety is critical because concentrations above 5% are described as lethal and strongly corrosive.
uses: Suppress developing fires and maintain CO₂ concentration to prevent reignition
Protect rooms and areas from fires involving combustible liquids, gases, electrical and electronic equipment, and some solid materials
furniture_equipment: Fire detection, control, alarm, and activation equipment

dimensions.label: Maximum floor area supplied per nozzle
dimensions.context: For systems intended to protect rooms, one nozzle may supply at most this floor area.
dimensions.ocr_raw: one nozzle may supply at most 30 m² of floor area

dimensions.label: Room height threshold
dimensions.context: For rooms higher than this, nozzles are installed at the ceiling and also at approximately one-third of room height.
dimensions.ocr_raw: If the room is more than 5 m high

dimensions.label: Additional nozzle position
dimensions.context: Approximate position for additional nozzles in rooms more than 5 m high; the printed fraction is one-third.
dimensions.ocr_raw: at approx. ⅓ of room height

dimensions.label: Lethal CO₂ concentration threshold
dimensions.context: Concentrations over this level are described as lethal and strongly corrosive.

fichas.title: Powder extinguisher systems
fichas.summary: Fire-extinguishing powders are chemical mixtures used for fires involving specified combustible solids, liquids, gases, and metals. Powder systems are used in industrial facilities but are unsuitable for certain dust-sensitive equipment, low-voltage electrical equipment, or locations where powder may cause a chemical reaction.
spaces: Filling, compressor, pumping, and transfer stations
uses: Extinguish fires involving suitable combustible solids, liquids, gases, and metals

dimensions.label: Operating temperature range
dimensions.context: Temperature range in which extinguisher powder can be used under normal conditions.

fichas.title: Foam extinguisher systems
fichas.summary: Foam is produced by combining water and foaming agent with air. Systems use heavy, medium, or light foam, with design depending on coverage, obstacles, object location, and foam characteristics. Water supply is sized for the largest object when multiple separate objects are protected by one system.
spaces: Areas or objects requiring precautionary fire coverage
uses: Extinguish fires and provide precautionary coverage
Cover protected areas with heavy or medium foam, or fill a room or building with light foam

dimensions.label: Minimum operating time for heavy foam
dimensions.context: Minimum water-supply operating duration for heavy-foam systems.
dimensions.ocr_raw: at least 120 min for heavy foam

dimensions.label: Minimum operating time for medium foam
dimensions.context: Minimum water-supply operating duration for medium-foam systems.
